newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two Chinese cosmonauts begin training in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Two Chinese cosmonauts begin training in Russia.

text.p: Two Chinese cosmonauts have started a training programme at Russia's Star City Space Centre for a mission due to lift off in 1999, an official spokesman said on Wednesday.
The spokesman said the two cosmonauts, We Jie and Li Qinlung, would study the full programme needed for manned space flight, coupled with intensive Russian lessons.
"They will study space navigation, astronomy, the equipment of an orbital station and other subjects, including an intensive course of physics," he said by telephone from Star City, near Moscow.
Russia and China signed an agreement to train Chinese cosmonauts in Russia after President Boris Yeltsin visited Bejing at the start of this year.
